sloka: अकाशमावृतं दृष्ट्वा देवैर्हि रघुनन्दनः ।सिंहनादं भृशं कृत्वा ददर्श लक्षणं पुनः ।। ७.६९.३२ ॥
transliteration: akāśamāvṛtaṁ dṛṣṭvā devairhi raghunandanaḥ ।siṁhanādaṁ bhṛśaṁ kṛtvā dadarśa lakṣaṇaṁ punaḥ ।। 7.69.32 ॥

translations.english: Indeed, having seen the sky covered by gods, Shatrughna, after letting out a loud lion's roar, saw Lakshmana again.
